m1.typescript: m1 every situation of the bank gets its mechanism and its reason

e1.typescript: e1 a rule that must hold goes to a hook whatever else is true

e2.typescript: e2 an outside system needs a server and noisy work alone needs a subagent

e3.typescript: e3 knowledge goes to the file or skill that loads it at the right time

e4.typescript: e4 a plugin carries a skill hook subagent or server to a second repository and nothing else

e5.typescript: e5 in an application the platform may supply the schema and only a remote server replaces your own tool

e6.typescript: e6 an unknown value is an error and a missing key takes its default

e7.typescript: e7 a pipeline a condition a long command and an event are not intervals

e8.typescript: e8 an interval is a loop in the session and a routine or desktop task when it must outlive it

e9.typescript: e9 a personal preference goes to a style a status line or a key binding and knowledge keeps its own rules

wrong-guarantee-needs-no-knowledge.defect: treats a rule as a hook only when no instruction text goes with it, so a rule with a convention is left to a sentence

wrong-server-skipped-when-noisy.defect: sends an outside system to a subagent when the work is also noisy

wrong-scope-ignored.defect: puts a path-scoped convention in the always-loaded file

wrong-one-reason-for-skills.defect: gives a repeatable procedure the reason code of a reference

wrong-plugin-at-one-repo.defect: makes a plugin even when only one repository needs the setup

wrong-plugin-for-conventions.defect: packages an instruction file as a plugin, which cannot carry one

wrong-api-provided-schema-ignored.defect: writes your own tool in an application even when the platform supplies the schema

wrong-api-server-without-remote.defect: uses the connector in an application when no remote server exists

wrong-no-validation.defect: accepts a knowledge kind it does not know

wrong-fallthrough-skill.defect: answers a situation that needs nothing special with a skill

wrong-timing-outranks-hook.defect: lets a schedule or an event decide before a rule that must hold every time

wrong-timing-outranks-noisy.defect: lets a schedule or an event decide before noisy work that needs its own context

wrong-no-timing-validation.defect: accepts a timing it does not know

wrong-away-sees-local-files.defect: lets a run with the computer off read local files

wrong-pipeline-as-loop.defect: treats a pipeline job as an ordinary job in the session

wrong-event-polled.defect: polls an event on a loop instead of watching its stream

wrong-no-expiry.defect: keeps a month-long job on a loop that expires after seven days

wrong-loop-while-away.defect: keeps an interval job on a loop when the computer will be off

wrong-voice-in-instruction-file.defect: puts a response style in the instruction file

wrong-display-as-style.defect: uses a response style for what a status line shows
